d:
Samajvadi parti ke varishth neta aazam khan uttar pradesh ki rajniti men ek bar phir sakriy nazar aa rahe hain. kaee bar vidhayak aur sansad rahe aazam khan, bite ek sal se jel men rahne ke bad riha hue hain. unki rihaee aise vakt huee hai jab uttar pradesh men vidhanasbha chunav ki sargarmiyan tez hone lagi hain.
Jel se bahar aate hi aazam khan ne asduddin ovaisi aur unki parti ko nishane par lena shuru kar diya hai. unke bayanon se saf hai ki vah uttar pradesh men ubhar rahe tisre rajnitik morche ko lekar khulkar hamlavar hain.
